query: For a 73‑year‑old female admitted with HHS, among female inpatients aged 68–78 with HHS versus all inpatients, what are: 72‑hour medication complexity distribution, median percentile rank of patients with hyperkalemia‑risk drug interactions, percent affected, and top‑quartile LOS and mortality?
final_sql: SELECT om.subject_id, om.is_affected, om.percentile_rank, om.max_los, om.max_mortality, (SELECT num_emars FROM emar_counts WHERE emar_id = om.subject_id) AS num_emars FROM om ORDER BY num_emars DESC NULLS LAST;
